title: ci(ui-merge): run objectui's Repo Gates in the root Lint UI job (18 of 19; the pre-install import graph waits for ui/.github to retire)

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSni6fCTRjRwzwXVWBfNomr)_

Fixes #25880
Part of #25677 (ui/ merge aftercare; #25697 roster row 24). Part of #25712 (4b): #25712 remains open; its 2d-2 / 2d-3 retire the nested workflow after this lands.

Body updated 2026-10-26T07:44Z: head `7a6678f0` (after #25963 and #25957 landed): all 19 gates, the Lint UI ceiling re-derived 30 → 40, counts and CI below re-read.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** 把 objectui 原来每个 PR 都跑的 `Repo Gates` 门禁(文档链接、文档里的组件类型、技能指南路径、文档代码片段编译、README 导出等)搬进根 `ci.yml` 的 `Lint UI` 作业,19 个门禁全部搬齐(第 19 个 pre-install import graph 在 #25957 改读根目录 workflow 后已转绿)。只改 `lint-ui` 这一段,外加按 F13 规则把该作业时限从 30 分钟重算为 40 分钟。
- **为什么改:** 合并到 `ui/` 之后 GitHub 只读根目录的 workflow,这批门禁从 10-25 22:51Z 起没有任何 PR 在跑。文档写错组件类型、技能指南引用死路径、提示词教了不渲染的组件键,都会悄悄合进 main。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** `Lint UI` 是必需检查。19 个门禁在合并后的树上全绿,CI 0 失败。代价:每个 ui PR 的 `Lint UI` 从约 112 秒(中位数)变为约 290 秒(本 PR 实测,其中过滤构建 121 秒);作业时限按 F13 规则 30 → 40 分钟(最慢 558 秒 + 新增约 174 秒 = 732 秒)。回滚 = 回退这一个提交。
- **席位意见:**
- **你要做的:** 以 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 账号审批(Tier H:`.github/workflows/ci.yml`)。必需检查集合不变,无需改 ruleset。

## What changed

`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `lint-ui` job only (+180 / −2), and the ceiling pin in `ui/scripts/__tests__/turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts` (+1 / −1):

- **15 install-free steps** (14 gates), placed before `Install dependencies` in `repo-gates.yml`'s order: Control Byte Scan, Action Ref Convention, Pre-Install Import Graph Check (self-test + run), Shell Escape Residue Scan, Inert vi.mock Specifier Check ×2, Internal Docs Link Check, Doc Fence Language Check (self-test + run), Doc Example Id Check, Doc Component Type Check ×2 (doc types, prompt keys), Skill Guide Path Check, Skill Eval Token Check ×2 (self-test, run), Docs Route Eager Closure Check.
- **9 steps after the job's last build** (5 gates): the two `--build-filter` derive steps (status captured before the output is written, as the nested workflow does), one `turbo run build --filter='./ui/packages/*' $SKILL_FILTER $SNIPPET_FILTER`, then Skill Example Check (self-test, run), Doc Snippet Type Check (emit census report-only, snippets, JSDoc examples, JSON fences), README Export Check.
- Every step keeps its nested `CHECK — STEP` name, so 2d-2 / 2d-3 can retarget the ui step-collector pins to the root job by path.
- Every new step runs `if: !cancelled()`, or on `steps.install` / `steps.ui-gate-build` succeeding, so one red gate does not hide another and a red lint step above hides none of the built-type gates. `Install dependencies` gains `id: install` and `if: !cancelled()` for that reason. The job's existing steps are unchanged and keep their implicit `success()`, so a red install-free gate still skips them, just as a red `lint:coverage` does today.
- Commands are spelled `pnpm --dir ui run ALIAS`, the convention the header above `type-check-ui` sets. Every script already had an alias in `ui/package.json`.
- Dropped in the port: the `.objectstack-pin` restore / build / save (the merged tree builds `@objectstack/*` from the workspace), and the nested turbo-cache report / prune / save bookkeeping (since #25963 the job's own restore, prune and bounded main-only save serve the build; its job-level run summaries put the gate build's tasks in the pruned seed).
- **Ceiling:** `timeout-minutes` 30 → 40, by the F13 rule in the comment above `lint-ui`: the old maximum of 558 s plus the ~174 s these gates add (first PR run 286 s less the 112 s median) gives 732 s, so max(3 × 12.2, 12.2 + 15) gives 40. `turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts` pins `UI_JOBS.lint` at the new value.

**Paths these gates read now:** `check:prompt-keys` reads the root `.github/prompts/` (3 files) and `check:pre-install-import-graph` reads the root workflows, both since #25957. `check:action-ref-convention` still scans `ui/.github/workflows/` (131 references in 26 files at the first head), so #25712 2d-3 retargets it when it deletes that directory.

The `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` set is untouched: everything lands inside the already-required `Lint UI`.

## Verification

On head `7a6678f0`:

- **Root gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` names 63. `--ran` reconciliation: 63 run, 0 NOT MEASURED, every one exit 0. `check:pm-dispatch-gates` is recorded from the push battery, which runs it.
- **Push battery:** `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs` printed `dispatch-gates self-test: 2182 cases pass.` It exited 0 in 1685 s with 0 failed.
- **ui tests that read the root `ci.yml`:** 35 files, 1233 tests passed. They include `turbo-cache-save-bound`, `check-pre-install-import-graph`, `report-turbo-cache` and `check-prompt-component-keys`.
- **CI** (run 40283902834): 61 check runs, 55 success, 6 skipped, 0 failed.

`Lint UI` before this PR, read from CI: 88 s (push run 40256110081), 111 s (PR run 40260334608) and 95 s (PR run 40254707398). After: 286 s on `5d06398c` (run 40262814083) and 290 s on `7a6678f0` (run 40283902834). In the second run the gate build took 121 s and the skill-example self-test 39 s.

## Acceptance notes

- **What the build replays.** The gate build took 121 s on both PR runs. A cold local build took 11m27s at `--concurrency=2`, so most of the CI build replays from the restored cache. After landing, `main` pushes save the pruned `lint-ui` seed, and it includes these tasks.
- The ceiling of 40 is an estimate built from one measured PR run of the added work. Re-derive it once `main` has a population of runs with these gates.
